concerns.text: The plan asserts compliance with Principle II ('No citation of unverified URLs'), but the dataset citation lacks a verified URL (see research.md where the dataset has no verified URL). This violates Constitution Principle II which requires all external citations to be verified.

The plan validates JSON files against their schemas, but does not explicitly validate the raw and processed CSV datasets against `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml`. Consequently the `dataset.schema.yaml` contract is never exercised, breaching the Plan ↔ contracts consistency requirement.
